items.title: What Does Becton Dickinson (BDX) First PowerPort Plaintiff Verdict Mean?
items.summary: Becton Dickinson (NYSE:BDX) lost the first federal bellwether trial over its Bard PowerPort device, with a jury siding with the plaintiff. The federal jury awarded significant compensatory damages to a patient who alleged serious health complications linked to PowerPort failure. This verdict is the first successful outcome for plaintiffs within the ongoing multi-district litigation over Bard PowerPort implants.
